purpose: Reconcile the current selected manufacturing-recovery hurdle to the older unchanged Foundry policy diagnostic. No extra cash saving or equity valuation is added.

2026_baseline.status: Q4 Foundry loss2.1B is owned;12.928B is annualized Q3 depreciation plus amortization, not full-year actual.

interpretation: This is a $19.2595B increase in the annual level of operating contribution before depreciation from the 2026 anchor to 2030, after ongoing manufacturing/process expenses. It is not $19B of cumulative cash flow and not $19B of cost cuts. Additional revenue and volume absorption can produce much of it.

The public source does not disclose how much normalized D&A belongs to each segment. Attributing all growth to Foundry is an explicit diagnostic, not observed segment EBITDA. Incremental external-packaging D&A/profit is excluded because it is independently funded and modeled.
A consistent internal-transfer convention is essential: any manufacturing improvement credited to Foundry cannot also be added as a new Products wafer-cost saving.
The lack of a complete Foundry revenue/wafer-cost bridge means node milestones and the total cash-capex allowance do not independently validate this dollar contribution hurdle.
